svg.title: Unlimited hf spectrogram
svg.desc: Waterfall of one hf transmission: tune at f_ref, sync markers, header staircase and data peaks on the 32-tone grid below f_ref.
svg.text: Spectrogram of the hf transmission “CQ DE PY2”
Real Encoder audio at 8 kHz; STFT with a 32 ms Hann window every 2 ms; power in dB relative to the strongest cell.
